hero.heading: DeSoto County, FL School Calendar 2026-2027
hero.mobileDescription: Students in the School District of DeSoto County start Aug 10, 2026, and ends May 27, 2027. There are three nine-day breaks and five early-release dates. Feb 15 is off unless used for weather make-up.
hero.desktopDescription: The school year in the School District of DeSoto County begins August 10, 2026, and ends May 27, 2027. Fall, Thanksgiving and spring breaks each span nine days, including weekends. There are five early-release dates. Students are scheduled to be off on February 15, but the district may use it as a weather make-up day.

editorialSummary.heading: Three nine-day breaks; Quarter 2 ends January 8
highlights: Fall, Thanksgiving and spring breaks each span nine days, including weekends
Students return January 4; Quarter 2 ends January 8 with early release
February 15 is a student holiday unless used for weather make-up
paragraphs: Fall break runs October 17–25, Thanksgiving break November 21–29, and spring break March 13–21. Each includes five weekdays without classes plus the weekends on either side. Students are scheduled to return from spring break on March 22, then have Good Friday off on March 26.

The district lists Christmas break as December 19–31, 2026. New Year's Day on January 1 and the following weekend extend the stretch without classes through January 3, so students are scheduled to return Monday, January 4.

Students are scheduled to be off on Presidents Day, February 15, 2027, while teachers have a workday. The district also lists the date as a possible weather make-up day, so families should check for changes before making plans. Classes end May 27, with graduation listed for May 28, a records day with no school. The annual PDF does not provide ceremony times or locations.

The five early-release school days are September 16 and October 16, 2026, and January 8, March 12 and April 7, 2027. October 16 and March 12 come immediately before fall and spring break, while January 8 ends Quarter 2. The district calendar does not specify dismissal times, so families should confirm pickup and bus arrangements with their school.

faqs.question: Which schools follow the DeSoto County 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: This is the districtwide calendar for The School District of DeSoto County in Arcadia, Florida. The district lists DeSoto County High School, DeSoto Middle School, DeSoto Secondary School, Memorial Elementary, Nocatee Elementary, and West Elementary. Individual schools may have additional events or program-specific schedules. This is not the calendar for DeSoto County Schools in Mississippi.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school in DeSoto County, FL, for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first day of school is Monday, August 10, 2026. The district also lists an open house on Thursday, August 6, before classes begin.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in DeSoto County, FL, for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The last day of school is Thursday, May 27, 2027. The district's annual calendar does not mark that date for early release. Graduation and a no-school records day are listed for Friday, May 28.

faqs.question: When is open house for DeSoto County schools in 2026?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists open house for Thursday, August 6, 2026, before classes begin on August 10. It does not specify visiting hours, so check your child's school for the time and arrangements.

faqs.question: When is fall break in DeSoto County, and when do students return?
faqs.answer: Fall break runs October 17–25, 2026, including both weekends. Students have no classes October 19–23 and are scheduled to return Monday, October 26. Friday, October 16, is an early-release school day before the break.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break for DeSoto County schools in 2026?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break is November 21–29, 2026. Students have the full week of November 23–27 off, along with the weekends before and after. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is winter break (Christmas break) in DeSoto County for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The district calls it Christmas Break and lists December 19–31, 2026. New Year's Day on January 1 and the following weekend extend the time without classes through January 3. Students are scheduled to return Monday, January 4, 2027.

faqs.question: When is spring break in DeSoto County, Florida, in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break runs March 13–21, 2027, including both weekends. Students are scheduled to return Monday, March 22. Friday, March 12, is an early-release school day and the last day of Quarter 3.

faqs.question: Do DeSoto County students have school on Good Friday in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, March 26, 2027, is a no-school holiday. It is separate from spring break, which ends March 21. Classes are scheduled for March 22–25, with students returning Monday, March 29, after Good Friday and the weekend.

faqs.question: What are the early-release dates for DeSoto County schools in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The five early-release dates are September 16 and October 16, 2026, and January 8, March 12 and April 7, 2027. Students attend school on all five dates. October 16, January 8 and March 12 are also the last days of Quarters 1, 2 and 3, respectively.

faqs.question: What time do DeSoto County schools dismiss on early-release days?
faqs.answer: The district's 2026-2027 annual calendar lists five early-release dates but does not provide dismissal times. Check your child's school for its dismissal schedule, bus arrangements and pickup instructions.

faqs.question: Is there school on Presidents Day in DeSoto County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Under the published calendar, students have no school on Monday, February 15, 2027, and teachers have a workday. However, the district also identifies February 15 as a potential inclement weather make-up day. Students may have to attend if the district activates that option.

faqs.question: Do DeSoto County schools close for Labor Day in 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, September 7, 2026, is a no-school holiday for Labor Day. Students are scheduled to return Tuesday, September 8.

faqs.question: Is Martin Luther King Jr. Day a school holiday in DeSoto County?
faqs.answer: Yes. The district calendar lists Monday, January 18, 2027, as a no-school holiday for Martin Luther King Jr. Day. Classes are scheduled to resume Tuesday, January 19.

faqs.question: Is Veterans Day a no-school day in DeSoto County in 2026?
faqs.answer: No. The district's published calendar does not list Wednesday, November 11, 2026, as a student holiday or early-release day. Students are scheduled to attend unless the district or their school announces a change.

faqs.question: When do the grading quarters end in DeSoto County in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Quarter 1 ends October 16, 2026; Quarter 2 ends January 8, 2027; and Quarter 3 ends March 12, 2027. All three dates are early-release school days. Quarter 2 continues after the January 4 return from Christmas break. The calendar lists May 27 as the last day of school but does not separately label it as the Quarter 4 end date.

faqs.question: How many student days are in the DeSoto County 2026-2027 school year?
faqs.answer: The official calendar lists 180 student days: 89 in the first semester and 91 in the second. The four quarters contain 49, 40, 43 and 48 student days. February 15 is currently scheduled as a student holiday but may be used for weather make-up.

faqs.question: When is graduation for DeSoto County schools in 2027?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists Friday, May 28, 2027, as Records Day/Graduation (No School). The last student day is Thursday, May 27. The annual PDF does not specify graduation ceremony times or locations, so confirm the arrangements with the school.

faqs.question: Does DeSoto County VPK follow the 2026-2027 school calendar?
faqs.answer: Yes. The district states that its 2026-2027 school-year Voluntary Prekindergarten (VPK) program follows the school calendar. Check the district's VPK information or your child's elementary school for program hours and any early-release arrangements.

faqs.question: Where can I find the official DeSoto County 2026-2027 school calendar PDF?
faqs.answer: The official 2026-2027 districtwide calendar PDF is linked from this page. It includes student holidays, breaks, early releases, open house and graduation. For later changes, check district announcements and your child's school, especially for any weather make-up decision.

faqs.question: Is September 16, 2026, a no-school day in DeSoto County?
faqs.answer: No. Wednesday, September 16, 2026, is an early-release school day for professional learning. Students attend school but leave early. The districtwide calendar does not list a dismissal time, so check your school's schedule.
